Things I've designed, built and led.

Two design projects first, then the teams and missions where I've taken on real responsibility.

WanderPages

A digital travel diary that follows a solo traveler through Italy, Japan, Morocco and India: a story of cultures tasted, streets walked and people met.

Role
UI/UX design
Tool
Figma
Format
6 screens, 4 chapters

Every chapter follows the same three parts: Culture, Food journal and Local experience.

Structure

Every chapter repeats the same three beats, so a reader always knows where they are.

Palette

Deep teal with warm gold keeps long reading calm and gives the pages a night-journal feel.

Type

A serif voice for titles and quotes makes it read like a diary, not an app.

Grocify

A grocery shopping app built around one clear path: find it, check it, add it, pay for it. I designed the four core mobile screens, from the home page to the cart.

Role
UI/UX design
Tool
Figma
Type
Design task, 4 mobile screens

What I designed

  • Search, delivery location and a first-order offer up front
  • Six photo category tiles for quick browsing
  • A product page with a quantity stepper and a sticky Add to Cart bar
  • A cart that shows subtotal, delivery and total at a glance
  • Five-tab bottom navigation: Home, Categories, Cart, Orders, Account
